{{Quote|Circlings are the Queen's advisers and upper-tier breeders. They're the most intelligent Quesoth, but they deal in words and thoughts, not actions.|Stromma Council Liaison Nyama|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
The '''Circling of the White''' was a caste of the [[Quesoth]] [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that advised the [[Queen of the White]], the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]]'s [[White City]], and [[Reproduction/Legends|bred]] Quesoth for their [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]. Once the [[Red City]]'s [[Queen of the Red]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] after ruling for a number of [[Standard year/Legends|years]], the [[Quesoth Soldier]]s, [[Workers (Quesoth)|Workers]], and their overseers, the [[Midli]], would travel to the White City while the Circling hibernated and bred a new Queen. Those who arrived at the White City then joined with the Queen's offspring, and after eighteen years, the [[Queen of the Black]] would arise, repeating the process.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the ruling [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Queen of the Red]] planned to kill the Circling of the White so the Queen of the White did not rise, allowing her to rule forever. Unfortunately for her, her ally, the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] did not succeed in [[Attack on the Red City|stealing]] [[juggernaut]]s from the [[Empire of the Hand]] during a battle against the government in the Red City. Without them, the Queen&mdash;who was murdered by Esva, who feared [[Treason/Legends|treason]]&mdash;was unable to raid the White City and stop the cycle.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Circling of the White was mentioned in the [[2011]] novella ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]] and included in ''[[Heir to the Empire: The 20th Anniversary Edition]]''.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
